_comment: Mountain Dusk by ansimuz -- CC0. See LICENSE.txt beside this file.
Layers back to front. Each is 320x240 and is drawn at 3x to span the
960-wide arena, anchored to the BOTTOM so the horizon and treeline sit
behind the fighters and the sky crops off the top -- the arena is 400 tall,
the scaled layer is 720, and the interesting 400 are the lower ones.
`dim` is how far the whole backdrop is faded toward the ground colour. The
house style is near-black with one accent (docs/DESIGN.md); a full-strength
dusk painting would fight the fighters for attention and drop the contrast
of the bone-white sprites below the point where the action reads.
